courses.overview: 以可遷移的傳力原理、施工方法與驗證比較相近的隧道與地下設施；關聯不表示同一業主、設計者、年代或規範。
courses.overviewEn: Compare neighbouring tunnels and underground works through transferable load-path principles, construction methods and verification; a link does not imply the same owner, designer, era or code.

related.title: 水平定向鑽掘導向
related.transfer: 可遷移「分段推力與反力連續」與「曲線管列與徑向作用」的傳力分析、量測與驗證方法；水平定向鑽掘導向的跨度、荷載、材料與允收條件需重新設定。
related.transferEn: The load-path analysis, measurement and verification methods of "Segment thrust and reaction continuity" and "Curved pipe strings and radial action" transfer, while ground conditions, loads, materials and acceptance conditions of Horizontal directional drilling guidance must be respecified.
related.difference: 本課聚焦頂管中繼站的分段受力、行程相容與局部接觸；水平定向鑽掘導向則以定向鑽掘的姿態積分、誤差來源與障礙淨距為重點，不能直接沿用參數或允收值。
related.differenceEn: This course focuses on intermediate-jacking segment forces, stroke compatibility and local contact; Horizontal directional drilling guidance centres on directional-drilling attitude integration, error sources and obstacle clearance, so parameters and acceptance values do not transfer unchanged.
practice: 比較系統邊界：列出「分段推力與反力連續」與「鑽桿長度與垂向投影」的荷載來源、傳力路徑與主要環境作用。
把本課算例的一個假設移到水平定向鑽掘導向，標出可沿用的方程與必須重設的參數。
以「設施淨距與不確定度」為例，設計一項能區分兩種結構行為的試驗或量測，並註明不確定度與允收準則。
practiceEn: Compare system boundaries: list the load sources, load paths and main environmental actions of “Segment thrust and reaction continuity” and “Rod length and vertical projection”.
Move one assumption of this course's worked example to Horizontal directional drilling guidance, separating reusable equations from parameters that must be respecified.
Using "Utility clearance and uncertainty", design a test or measurement that distinguishes the two structural behaviours and state its uncertainty and acceptance criterion.

related.title: 豎井沉井施工
related.transfer: 可遷移「分段推力與反力連續」與「曲線管列與徑向作用」的傳力分析、量測與驗證方法；豎井沉井施工的跨度、荷載、材料與允收條件需重新設定。
related.transferEn: The load-path analysis, measurement and verification methods of "Segment thrust and reaction continuity" and "Curved pipe strings and radial action" transfer, while ground conditions, loads, materials and acceptance conditions of Sinking-caisson shaft construction must be respecified.
related.difference: 本課聚焦頂管中繼站的分段受力、行程相容與局部接觸；豎井沉井施工則以沉井下沉平衡、刃腳接觸與封底抗浮為重點，不能直接沿用參數或允收值。
related.differenceEn: This course focuses on intermediate-jacking segment forces, stroke compatibility and local contact; Sinking-caisson shaft construction centres on sinking-caisson equilibrium, cutting-edge contact and base-plug uplift, so parameters and acceptance values do not transfer unchanged.
practice: 比較系統邊界：列出「分段推力與反力連續」與「下沉驅動與力系平衡」的荷載來源、傳力路徑與主要環境作用。
把本課算例的一個假設移到豎井沉井施工，標出可沿用的方程與必須重設的參數。
以「位移速率與突沉辨識」為例，設計一項能區分兩種結構行為的試驗或量測，並註明不確定度與允收準則。
practiceEn: Compare system boundaries: list the load sources, load paths and main environmental actions of “Segment thrust and reaction continuity” and “Sinking drive and force equilibrium”.
Move one assumption of this course's worked example to Sinking-caisson shaft construction, separating reusable equations from parameters that must be respecified.
Using "Movement rate and sudden-sinking detection", design a test or measurement that distinguishes the two structural behaviours and state its uncertainty and acceptance criterion.

history.year: 公開工程脈絡 / Public engineering context
history.title: 頂管中繼推進站
history.text: 本課討論的頂管中繼站的分段受力、行程相容與局部接觸，反映地下工程由單一構件強度走向地層、施工時序與維護共同驗證的發展。中繼站重分配管列推力而不創造免反力推進；靜態分段模型未包含設備同步、地層非線性及動態衝擊。 1992 年 CEDD 岩洞指南初版、2009 年 FHWA 隧道土木手冊及 2018 年岩洞指南第二版提供公開閱讀脈絡。FHWA 公開章節區分 HDD、頂管與微型隧道，PJA 資料提供管列荷載與公差的閱讀脈絡；城市管線走廊為假想場景，本課不主張取得其專有圖說或現場數據，只重建公開原理。
history.textEn: The focus on intermediate-jacking segment forces, stroke compatibility and local contact reflects the development from isolated member strength toward combined ground, sequence and maintenance verification. Intermediate stations redistribute pipeline thrust rather than provide reaction-free advance; static segment models omit synchronization, nonlinear ground response and dynamic impact. The 1992 first CEDD cavern guide, 2009 FHWA civil tunnel manual and 2018 second cavern-guide edition provide public context. FHWA distinguishes HDD, pipe jacking and microtunneling; PJA provides reading context for pipe loads and tolerances. The urban utility corridor is a hypothetical setting. This course claims no proprietary drawings or field data and reconstructs public principles.
